verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a search that works offline on all devices, returns quick results, and tolerates inexact wording, which covers instant full-text search including offline. Filtering is thinly evidenced: 'Smart queries' appears only as a pricing feature and tags only in a community comment. Missing for 10: documented search filters on tags and properties, any path/folder filtering, explicit confirmation that search covers full note body text, and independent hands-on corroboration of offline search speed.
